problem_statement: The website-templates/webstudio_responsive-template project is a Webstudio responsive marketing homepage shipped as a static Gulp build (build/index.html + Pug/Stylus source) with a header nav, Register/Log in actions, a hero slider with local slide images, a 'From the studio log' credentials band, and a 'Selected work' project showcase whose category filter (All work / Web / Branding / Motion) filters six project cards and shows a live 'Showing N of 6' readout, plus lower content/testimonial blocks, a Request a design CTA, a newsletter form, and a social footer; the studio's Selected-work showcase is meant to appear on both the Home page and the About page. A QA bug report says the Selected-work showcase is broken three ways: (1) at 390px the filter tab row is a fixed-width no-wrap row wider than the viewport, so the whole page scrolls sideways (horizontal overflow) while desktop and tablet look fine; (2) on desktop the six project cards overlap into an unreadable stacked pile with dark-on-dark text and washed-out tabs instead of a clean readable grid; (3) clicking a category tab filters the visible cards but the 'Showing N of 6' readout stays frozen on 'Showing 6 of 6 · All work' instead of updating to the selected category and count; and the showcase is missing from the About page entirely. Repair the Selected-work showcase so the filter tab row and card grid wrap/flow within the 390px mobile viewport with no horizontal overflow, the six cards render as a clean readable non-overlapping grid on desktop, the readout updates to the selected category and count on every tab click, and the showcase is present on both the Home and About pages, while preserving the slider, hero copy, studio-log band, header nav/actions, lower marketing sections, request CTA, newsletter, footer, static serving behavior, and the desktop/tablet appearance of the rest of the page.
required_content: Fix the Selected-work filter so the 390px mobile homepage has no horizontal overflow (the tab row and card grid wrap/flow within the viewport).

Render the six Selected-work project cards as a clean, readable, non-overlapping grid on desktop with legible card names and tab labels (no dark-on-dark or washed-out text, no stacked/overlapping cards).

Wire the category tabs (All work / Web / Branding / Motion) so clicking a tab filters the visible cards AND updates the 'Showing N of 6 · <category>' readout to match the selected category and count (e.g. 'Showing 2 of 6 · Branding').
Show the Selected-work showcase on BOTH the Home page and the About page (about.html), keeping the 'Selected work' heading and the six project cards on each.
Keep the studio-log band content intact: the 'From the studio log' heading and the four metric tiles (128 designs delivered, 9 years on the web, 40 happy clients, 6 people on the team).
Preserve the three slide titles Design example, slide images slide-one.png, slide-two.png, slide-three.png, View more of this design links, and radio-label slider controls intact.

Preserve the header links Home, About, Blog, Contact, Register, Log in, the Your ideas live in no-time! logo text, Why choose WebOnDemand?, Testimonials, Request a design, Newsletter, and footer social links.

Keep the page runnable as the existing static template without adding npm scripts, framework code, external runtime services, or new dependencies; keep the built pages consistent with the source repair.
Keep desktop, tablet, and 390px mobile captures free of horizontal overflow and free of new console/network errors.
design_constraints: This is a component repair of the existing Selected-work showcase, not a redesign; do not change the slider layout, black rounded panel, radio controls, slide image placement, or the rest of the Webstudio marketing visual system.
Do not replace local slide assets, testimonial avatars, or footer structure.
Keep the served static build and its source consistent so the benchmark browser sees the repaired responsive, readable, correctly-wired showcase.
Avoid adding explanatory benchmark labels, debug banners, cards, or hidden-only text; the showcase should read like a normal marketing work grid.
state_constraints: desktop_home and mobile_home verify the static marketing shell renders with header, logo, slider, studio-log band, and the Selected-work showcase present.

mobile_home and mobile_content are the responsive discriminator states: the repaired filter tab row and card grid must produce no horizontal overflow at 390px (the unrepaired row overflows ~300-350px).
desktop_content scrolls to the Selected-work grid to confirm the six cards render as a clean readable non-overlapping grid (the broken version overlaps them into an illegible dark-on-dark pile).
desktop_about confirms the Selected-work showcase is present on the About page (the broken version omits it there).
desktop_projfilter clicks the Branding tab and confirms the readout updates to 'Showing 2 of 6 · Branding' (the broken version leaves the readout frozen on 'Showing 6 of 6 · All work').
tablet_home and desktop_home confirm the wider viewports remain overflow-free with the cards laid out as a grid.
desktop_footer confirms the footer social links remain present after the repair.

change_completion: The 390px mobile homepage renders with no horizontal overflow after the Selected-work showcase repair.
Clicking a category tab filters the visible cards and updates the 'Showing N of 6' readout to the selected category and count.
regression: Header nav/actions, logo text, slide titles, slide images, View more links, studio-log band, content blocks, request CTA, newsletter, and footer social links remain present.
The pages remain a static build template with no new runtime or dependency requirement.
design_consistency: The six project cards render as a clean readable non-overlapping grid with legible names and tab labels, continuous with the Webstudio marketing style.
The repair does not introduce benchmark labels, banners, or unrelated content, and the Selected-work showcase appears on both Home and About.
responsive: Desktop, tablet, and mobile captures render with no horizontal overflow.
The filter tab row and card grid wrap/flow within the mobile viewport while remaining a grid on desktop/tablet.

scoring_notes: A correct patch repairs the existing Selected-work showcase: (a) make the filter tab row and card grid wrap within the 390px viewport (no horizontal overflow past the 24px tolerance), (b) render the six cards as a clean readable non-overlapping grid on desktop (no negative-margin overlap, no dark-on-dark or washed-out text), (c) update the 'Showing N of 6 · <category>' readout on every tab click, and (d) render the showcase on both Home and About. Leaving the fixed-width no-wrap tab row (mobile overflow), leaving the cards overlapping/illegible, leaving the readout frozen after a tab click, or omitting the showcase from the About page should fail the no_horizontal_overflow, visual_regression, interaction_assertions, or dom_assertions checks respectively.
